title: T-28 EVIDENCE (no fix): 'the other player seems to hold a box they don't have'. The HOST holds a box through the game's own carry path, then the client's figure on the host is re-spawned through the mod's own path (RemotePlayerManager.Remove -> next packet -> SpawnRemotePlayer, which copies the host's own body); the list shows whether a box the mod did not attach (FOREIGN, not BAMP_*) sits in the re-spawned figure's hand. NO save
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, client Client1). Dev build with src/DevT28.cs (lever `handbox`) on the HOST. Both players stand idle in the world; the client keeps sending position packets (the re-spawn waits for the next one). `handbox respawn` also despawns the client's vehicles on the host (RemotePlayerManager.Remove -> VehicleManager.DespawnAllOwnedBy). NOTHING is saved.

steps.note: waits for the host's own settle line (searched from its step-4 mark)
waits for the client's own settle line (searched from its step-4 mark)
client position packets reach the host and spawn the client's figure
PREMISE: the host's hands start empty
BASELINE: the client's figure as first spawned (host empty-handed) - foreign= is expected 0
PREMISE: the host REALLY holds a box - game state (ItemInstanceInHands) AND an active object under its own HandContent

steps.expect_result: ^OK handbox respawn '${clientPid}' removed .*local hands at removal=ba:itemname_closedcardboardbox
steps.note: the figure is removed while the host holds the box; the next position packet re-spawns it by copying the host's body

steps.expect_result: ^OK handbox list '${clientPid}' fresh=yes handContent=yes mod=0 foreign=0 .*localHolding=ba:itemname_closedcardboardbox
steps.note: EVIDENCE: foreign>=1 (a FOREIGN:* item under HandContent) = a box the mod did not attach sits in the client's figure's hand; foreign=0 = the copy mechanism does not reproduce. Not asserted either way | T-28 FIX PROOF: the figure must hold nothing copied from the host (foreign=0).

steps.expect_result: ^OK handbox list '${clientPid}' fresh=yes handContent=yes mod=0 foreign=0 .*localHolding=none
steps.note: EVIDENCE (persistence): after the host drops its box, does the FOREIGN item stay in the figure's hand (the 'permanently holding a box' report) | T-28 FIX PROOF: the figure must hold nothing copied from the host (foreign=0).
